# Marcus Maute

> Lead author of the Agentic Finance Report (2026) and TensorX Swiss Representative, based in Zürich. Works on how regulated financial institutions let AI agents act on capital inside mandates people write and control: the mandate first, then the stack.

- Markdown edition: https://www.marcusmaute.com/marcus-maute.md — one site-wide, factual Markdown document (who Marcus is, the report, Neo, talks, writing, every page). Every page also carries it inline: an "Agent" toggle in the nav (or `#agent` in the URL) swaps the page for this Markdown, with a copy button and a download link.
- Name: Marcus Maute
- Role: TensorX Swiss Representative (https://tensorx.ai)
- Location: Zürich, Switzerland
- Languages: English, German
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcusmaute/

## Neo

Neo (https://github.com/DerMarcus/nftneo): an autonomous agent that collects fully on-chain generative art, built and operated by Marcus Maute as an independent personal project. Publishes its valuation before every acquisition; can buy and structurally cannot sell; pre-launch as of September 2026.

## The Agentic Finance Report (2026)

- Website and downloads: https://agenticfinancereport.com/ (PDF and Markdown editions from 29 September 2026; machine-readable index at https://agenticfinancereport.com/llms.txt)
- Lead author: Marcus Maute (executive summary, chapter 02 "What Is Agentic Finance?", chapter 08 "Conclusions & Recommendations")
- Co-authors: TensorX, AMINA Bank, Solana Foundation, APEX:E3, Cardano Foundation. Guest contribution: Blindsight. Foreword: Tim Grant, Executive Chairman, TensorX
- Launch: CV Summit 2026, Kongresshaus Zurich, 29–30 September 2026. Distribution partner: CV VC
- Definition: Agentic Finance is capital managed continuously rather than periodically, by software acting inside mandates that people write and can withdraw, on rails that settle at machine speed
- Five preconditions (chapter 08): the asset is held by a regulated institution; the rail settles finally and cheaply; the reasoning runs where the institution can see it; the decision is attributable to the agent that made it; the agent is identifiable as acting for a legal entity
- Figures of $4.8 trillion addressable capital and ~200 bps uplift are modelled by APEX:E3, not measured
- Cite: Maute, M. (ed.), with TensorX, AMINA Bank, Solana Foundation, APEX:E3 and Cardano Foundation; guest contribution by Blindsight (2026). Agentic Finance Report. Industry report, edition 1.0. agenticfinancereport.com
